tasks.title: Add a development-only sign-in in `apps/app/src/auth/dev.ts`

evidence.reason: Verified local-only RS256 sign-in using seeded identities and the existing verifier/session/authorization pipeline. Tests cover disabled 404 routes, production and unsafe-binding refusal, CSRF/body limits, current role/revocation, pending activation, tampered cookies/header refusal, switching and both logout paths, opt-in/key persistence, deployment refusal and HTTP credential-file denial.
